features.native: Vula ikhadi lengadi ukuze ubone umlimi wayo, izithombe nezindawo zokutshala. Sebenzisa imephu ukuze ubone ukuthi ikuphi.
features.source: Open a garden card to see its grower, photographs and growing areas. Use the map to explore where it is.

features.native: Izindawo ezilandelayo zixhumanisa ukwakheka kwengadi nezifundo zayo, okuvunyiwe, ukuthengisa nemibiko yohlelo.
features.source: The next stops connect a garden design with its studies, harvests, sales and programme reports.

features.native: Isinyathelo esithi Isisekelo sigcina isithombe sesayithi. Kokuthi Glossy, sebenzisa okuthi Isendlalelo esingaphansi ukuze ushintshe phakathi kwesithombe sakho, isithombe sesathelayithi nephepha elingenalutho.
features.source: The Base step holds the site image. In Glossy, use Underlay to switch between your photo, satellite and plain paper.

features.native: Khetha isihlahla noma umbhede bese uwuhudula. Ukuhlehlisa kubuyisela indawo yawo yangaphambilini. Iphaneli ethi Izendlalelo ilawula ukuthi yiziphi izinto ongazikhetha uzisuse.
features.source: Select a tree or bed and drag it. Undo restores the previous position. The Layers panel controls which items you can select and move.

features.native: Khetha Isango kokuthi Izakhiwo. Hudula isibambo salo esiluhlaza ukuze ulibeke; isibambo esisagolide esisekugcineni sishintsha ubude balo. Imephu ephelile ikhombisa isango livuliwe futhi lishiya indawo yokungena ocingweni.
features.source: Choose a Gate in Structures. Drag its green move handle to position it; the gold end handle changes its length. The finished map shows the gate open and leaves an opening in the fence.

features.native: Vula i-Glossy, khetha ishidi nesendlalelo salo esingaphansi, bese wenza Imephu Yokuklama. Hlola umphumela esikrinini esigcwele bese usebenzisa okuthi Thumela futhi Yabelana kumashidi owakhethile.
features.source: Open Glossy, choose a sheet and its underlay, then create a Design Map. Inspect the result full screen and use Export & Share for your selected sheets.

features.native: Sebenzisa okuthi Qala ukufunda noma Qhubeka nokufunda ukuze uvule imojuli yakho elandelayo. Amakhadi anezithombe akhombisa izihloko nenqubekelaphambili yakho.
features.source: Use Start studying or Continue learning to open your next module. Illustrated cards show the topics and your progress.

features.native: Vula okuthi Imbewu Nobukhosi Bembewu ukuze uzame imojuli ephelile. Khetha isithombe noma isihloko sesifundo ukuze ufunde, ulalele, ubuke izilayidi uphendule imibuzo.
features.source: Open Seeds and Seed Sovereignty to try a finished module. Choose a lesson picture or title to read, listen, watch slides and answer a quiz.

features.native: Vula okuthi Funda ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi usenophawu lwenethiwekhi. Khetha ikhwalithi yokulanda bese ugcina isifundo noma imojuli eyodwa kule foni.
features.source: Open Study offline while you have signal. Choose the download quality and save the course or a single module to this phone.

features.native: Okukhethiwe kurekhoda isivuno; Okuthengisiwe kurekhoda ukuthengisa; Okusetshenzisiwe kugcina izindleko; Amashadi ahlanganisa izibalo. Shintsha amathebhu ukuze ulandele umsebenzi kusukela esitshalweni kuye emalini.
features.source: Picked records harvests; Sold records sales; Spent holds costs; Charts brings the figures together. Switch tabs to follow the work from crop to cash.

features.native: Vula i-invoyisi, bese uvula Okulondoloziwe ukuze uhlole idokhumenti. Kokuthi Okusetshenzisiwe, vula irisidi ukuze ubone imininingwane yokuthenga ehambisana nezindleko.
features.source: Open Invoice, then Saved, to inspect a document. In Spent, open a receipt to see the purchase details behind a cost.

features.native: Kokuthi Okukhethiwe, vula Imibiko yomabolekisi ukuze ubuke umlando wesivuno, wemali engenayo nowezindleko bese uthumela isifinyezo.
features.source: In Picked, open Records for a lender to view harvest, income and cost history and export the summary.

features.native: Umsebenzi wasensimini uvula imisebenzi okufanele yenziwe, ukumbozwa kwabahlanganyeli nomhlahlandlela wokuvakasha wokuhlola ukutholakala kokudla. Vula Abantu nezingadi ukuze uqale ukuvakasha kukhethwe umhlanganyeli ofanele.
features.source: Fieldwork opens your due actions, participant coverage and food-security visit guide. Open People & gardens to start a visit with the participant already selected.

features.native: Sebenzisa Ukufunda ukuze ubuke inqubekelaphambili yamamojuli, nokuQeqesha ukuze ubuke ukuba khona, izitifiketi nempendulo. Ekuvakasheni kwasensimini, rekhoda ikhono olibone nesinyathelo esilandelayo, umuntu ozosenza nosuku.
features.source: Use Learning for module progress and Training for attendance, certificates and feedback. In a field visit, record the skill observed and the next action, owner and date.

features.native: Qhathanisa amaqembu, izingadi nomsebenzi orekhodiwe. Vula Ukuhlolwa ukuze ubuyekeze izigaba zohlolo nezimpendulo.
features.source: Compare groups, gardens and recorded activity. Open Assessments to review the survey stages and responses.

features.native: Ukuqeqeshwa nenqubekelaphambili kuhlanganisa ubufakazi bokuqeqeshwa nobomsebenzi. Imibiko ilungiselela irekhodi lohlelo ukuze libuyekezwe futhi kwabelwane ngalo.
features.source: Training & progress brings training and project evidence together. Reports prepares the programme record for review and sharing.

features.native: Hlola izibalo namashadi eqembu, bese uvula Inqubekelaphambili nezinyathelo ezibalulekile ukuze ubone irekhodi lohlelo olubanzi.
features.source: Explore cohort totals and charts, then Progress & milestones for the wider programme record.

features.native: Vula ukuhlolwa nemibiko eyabiwe ukuze ubone amarekhodi asekelayo izibalo nomsebenzi okusamele wenziwe.
features.source: Open shared assessments and reports to see the records supporting the totals and the work still to be completed.

features.native: Amasayithi nemibiko egciniwe ixhumanisa isayithi ngalinye nemibiko yalo. Khetha isayithi ukuze wenze umbiko ngolwazi lwalo lwamanje.
features.source: Saved sites & reports connects each site to its reports. Choose a site to create a report from its current information.

features.native: Bheka uhlu lwesayithi lwezithombe, izivivinyo zomhlabathi nezamanzi, izimpendulo zohlolo nomsebenzi wokuklama. Landa umbiko wobufakazi ukuze ubone idokhumenti ephelile.
features.source: Review the site checklist for photographs, soil and water tests, survey answers and design work. Download the evidence report to see the finished document.

features.native: Khetha okuthi Cela isici ukuze uchaze ushintsho nekhasi lohlelo oluthintekayo. Landa ikhophi yohlaka lwakho, noma ungene ngemvume ukuze uluthumele kumthuthukisi.
features.source: Choose Request a feature to describe the change and the app page. Download a copy of your draft, or sign in to send it to the developer.

features.native: Bula karete ya serapa ho bona molemi wa sona, ditshwantsho le dibaka tsa ho lema. Sebelisa mmapa ho lekola moo se leng teng.
features.source: Open a garden card to see its grower, photographs and growing areas. Use the map to explore where it is.

features.native: Mehato e latelang e hokahanya moralo wa serapa le dithuto tsa sona, kotulo, thekiso le ditlaleho tsa lenaneo.
features.source: The next stops connect a garden design with its studies, harvests, sales and programme reports.

features.native: Mohato wa Motheo o na le setshwantsho sa sebaka. Ho Glossy, sebelisa Lera le ka tlase ho fapanyetsana pakeng tsa setshwantsho sa hao, sa sathelaete le pampiri e sa ngolwang.
features.source: The Base step holds the site image. In Glossy, use Underlay to switch between your photo, satellite and plain paper.

features.native: Kgetha sefate kapa bethe mme o e hule. Kgutlisa e e busetsa boemong ba pele. Phanele ya Mera e laola dintho tseo o ka di kgethang le ho di suthisa.
features.source: Select a tree or bed and drag it. Undo restores the previous position. The Layers panel controls which items you can select and move.

features.native: Kgetha Heke ho Mehaho. Hula motshwari wa yona o motala ho e beha; motshwari wa kgauta o qetellong o fetola bolelele ba yona. Mmapa o felileng o bontsha heke e butswe mme o siya sekgeo terateng.
features.source: Choose a Gate in Structures. Drag its green move handle to position it; the gold end handle changes its length. The finished map shows the gate open and leaves an opening in the fence.

features.native: Bula Glossy, kgetha leqephe le lera la lona le ka tlase, ebe o etsa Mmapa wa Moralo. Hlahloba sephetho sekirining se felletseng mme o sebedise Romela le Arolelana bakeng sa maqephe ao o a kgethileng.
features.source: Open Glossy, choose a sheet and its underlay, then create a Design Map. Inspect the result full screen and use Export & Share for your selected sheets.

features.native: Sebelisa Qala ho ithuta kapa Tswela pele ho ithuta ho bula mojule wa hao o latelang. Dikarete tse nang le ditshwantsho di bontsha dihlooho le tswelopele ya hao.
features.source: Use Start studying or Continue learning to open your next module. Illustrated cards show the topics and your progress.

features.native: Bula Seeds and Seed Sovereignty ho leka mojule o felileng. Kgetha setshwantsho kapa sehlooho sa thuto ho bala, ho mamela, ho sheba diselaete le ho araba dipotso.
features.source: Open Seeds and Seed Sovereignty to try a finished module. Choose a lesson picture or title to read, listen, watch slides and answer a quiz.

features.native: Bula Ithute ntle le inthanete ha o sa na le kgokahano. Kgetha boleng ba ho kopitsa mme o boloke thupelo kapa mojule o le mong fonong ena.
features.source: Open Study offline while you have signal. Choose the download quality and save the course or a single module to this phone.

features.native: Kotutswe e rekota kotulo; Rekisitswe e rekota thekiso; Sebediswe e boloka ditshenyehelo; Dikerafo e kopanya dipalo. Fetola dithepo ho latela mosebetsi ho tloha sejalong ho ya tjheleteng.
features.source: Picked records harvests; Sold records sales; Spent holds costs; Charts brings the figures together. Switch tabs to follow the work from crop to cash.

features.native: Bula Invoyese, ebe Bolokilwe, ho hlahloba tokomane. Ho Sebediswe, bula rasiti ho bona dintlha tsa theko tse amanang le tshenyehelo.
features.source: Open Invoice, then Saved, to inspect a document. In Spent, open a receipt to see the purchase details behind a cost.

features.native: Ho Kotutswe, bula Direkoto bakeng sa mobolekisi ho bona nalane ya kotulo, lekeno le ditshenyehelo mme o romele kakaretso e le faele.
features.source: In Picked, open Records for a lender to view harvest, income and cost history and export the summary.

features.native: Mosebetsi wa masimong o bula mesebetsi ya hao e lokelang ho etswa, hore na ke barupeluoa bafe ba seng ba fihletswe, le tataiso ya ketelo ya tshireletso ya dijo. Bula Batho le dirapa ho qala ketelo morupeluoa a se a kgethilwe.
features.source: Fieldwork opens your due actions, participant coverage and food-security visit guide. Open People & gardens to start a visit with the participant already selected.

features.native: Sebelisa Ho ithuta bakeng sa tswelopele ya dimojule le Thupelo bakeng sa boteng, disetifikeiti le maikutlo. Ketelong ya masimong, rekota bokgoni boo o bo boneng le kgato e latelang, ya e ikarabellang le letsatsi.
features.source: Use Learning for module progress and Training for attendance, certificates and feedback. In a field visit, record the skill observed and the next action, owner and date.

features.native: Bapisa dihlopha, dirapa le mosebetsi o rekotilweng. Bula Ditekolo ho hlahloba mekhahlelo ya dipatlisiso le dikarabo.
features.source: Compare groups, gardens and recorded activity. Open Assessments to review the survey stages and responses.

features.native: Thupelo le tswelopele e kopanya bopaki ba thupelo le ba projeke. Ditlaleho e lokisetsa rekoto ya lenaneo hore e hlahlojwe le ho arolelanwa.
features.source: Training & progress brings training and project evidence together. Reports prepares the programme record for review and sharing.

features.native: Lekola dipalo tsa sehlopha le dikerafo, ebe Tswelopele le diketsahalo tsa bohlokwa bakeng sa rekoto e batsi ya lenaneo.
features.source: Explore cohort totals and charts, then Progress & milestones for the wider programme record.

features.native: Bula ditekolo le ditlaleho tse arolelanweng ho bona direkoto tse tshehetsang dipalo le mosebetsi o sa ntseng o lokela ho phethwa.
features.source: Open shared assessments and reports to see the records supporting the totals and the work still to be completed.

features.native: Dibaka le ditlaleho tse bolokilweng e hokahanya sebaka ka seng le ditlaleho tsa sona. Kgetha sebaka ho etsa tlaleho ka lesedi la sona la jwale.
features.source: Saved sites & reports connects each site to its reports. Choose a site to create a report from its current information.

features.native: Hlahloba lenane la sebaka bakeng sa ditshwantsho, diteko tsa mobu le metsi, dikarabo tsa dipatlisiso le mosebetsi wa ho rala. Kopitsa tlaleho ya bopaki ho bona tokomane e felileng.
features.source: Review the site checklist for photographs, soil and water tests, survey answers and design work. Download the evidence report to see the finished document.

features.native: Kgetha Kopa tshebetso ho hlalosa phetoho le leqephe la app. Kopitsa faele ya moralo wa hao, kapa kena ho e romela ho moetsi wa app.
features.source: Choose Request a feature to describe the change and the app page. Download a copy of your draft, or sign in to send it to the developer.

features.native: Pfula khadi ra xirhapa leswaku u vona murimi wa xona, swifaniso ni tindhawu to byala. Tirhisa mepe ku kambela laha xi nga kona.
features.source: Open a garden card to see its grower, photographs and growing areas. Use the map to explore where it is.

features.native: Switichi leswi landzelaka swi hlanganisa dizayini ya xirhapa ni tidyondzo ta xona, ntshovelo, ku xavisa ni swiviko swa nongonoko.
features.source: The next stops connect a garden design with its studies, harvests, sales and programme reports.

features.native: Goza ra Masungulo ri ni xifaniso xa ndhawu. Eka Glossy, tirhisa Leyara ya le hansi ku cinca phakathi ka xifaniso xa wena, xa sathelayiti ni phepha leri nga tsariwangiki.
features.source: The Base step holds the site image. In Glossy, use Underlay to switch between your photo, satellite and plain paper.

features.native: Hlawula murhi kumbe mubedo kutani u wu koka. Tlherisela swi tlherisela ndhawu ya le ku sunguleni. Phanele ya Tileya yi lawula leswi u nga swi hlawulaka ni ku swi susumeta.
features.source: Select a tree or bed and drag it. Undo restores the previous position. The Layers panel controls which items you can select and move.

features.native: Hlawula Gede eka Miako. Koka xikhomo xa yona xa rihlaza leswaku u yi veka; xikhomo xa nsuku emakumu xi cinca ku leha ka yona. Mepe lowu heleleke wu komba gede yi pfulekile naswona wu siya xivandla erihlampfungwini.
features.source: Choose a Gate in Structures. Drag its green move handle to position it; the gold end handle changes its length. The finished map shows the gate open and leaves an opening in the fence.

features.native: Pfula Glossy, hlawula pheji ni leyara ya yona ya le hansi, kutani u endla Mepe wa Dizayini. Kambela mbuyelo eka xikirini hinkwaxo kutani u tirhisa Humesa ni Avelana eka mapheji lawa u ma hlawuleke.
features.source: Open Glossy, choose a sheet and its underlay, then create a Design Map. Inspect the result full screen and use Export & Share for your selected sheets.

features.native: Tirhisa Sungula ku dyondza kumbe Yana mahlweni u dyondza ku pfula mojulu wa wena lowu landzelaka. Makhadi ya swifaniso ma komba tinhlokomhaka ni nhluvuko wa wena.
features.source: Use Start studying or Continue learning to open your next module. Illustrated cards show the topics and your progress.

features.native: Pfula Seeds and Seed Sovereignty leswaku u ringeta mojulu lowu heleleke. Hlawula xifaniso kumbe nhlokomhaka ya dyondzo leswaku u hlaya, u yingisela, u hlalela swilayidi ni ku hlamula swivutiso.
features.source: Open Seeds and Seed Sovereignty to try a finished module. Choose a lesson picture or title to read, listen, watch slides and answer a quiz.

features.native: Pfula Dyondza handle ka inthanete loko wa ha ri ni vuhlanganisi. Hlawula khwalithi yo kopa kutani u hlayisa khoso kumbe mojulu wun’we eka riqingho leri.
features.source: Open Study offline while you have signal. Choose the download quality and save the course or a single module to this phone.

features.native: Ntshovelo swi rekhoda ntshovelo; Ku xavisa swi rekhoda ku xavisa; Tihakelo swi hlayisa tihakelo; Tichati ti hlanganisa tinhlayo. Cinca tithebhu ku landzela umsebenzi ku suka eka xibyariwa ku ya eka mali.
features.source: Picked records harvests; Sold records sales; Spent holds costs; Charts brings the figures together. Switch tabs to follow the work from crop to cash.

features.native: Pfula Invoyisi, kutani Hlayisiwile, leswaku u kambela tsalwa. Eka Tihakelo, pfula risiti ku vona vuxokoxoko bya ku xava loku khumbaka mali leyi tirhisiweke.
features.source: Open Invoice, then Saved, to inspect a document. In Spent, open a receipt to see the purchase details behind a cost.

features.native: Eka Ntshovelo, pfula Tirhekhodo ta ku nyika mubolekisi leswaku u vona matimu ya ntshovelo, mali leyi nghenaka ni leyi tirhisiwaka kutani u humesa nkatsakanyo wu va fayili.
features.source: In Picked, open Records for a lender to view harvest, income and cost history and export the summary.

features.native: Ntirho wa le masin’wini wu pfula mintirho leyi faneleke ku endliwa, leswaku hi vahi vatekaxiave lava se va fikeleriweke, ni nkongomiso wa riendzo ra vuhlayiseki bya swakudya. Pfula Vanhu ni swirhapa ku sungula riendzo mutekaxiave a ri se a hlawuriwile.
features.source: Fieldwork opens your due actions, participant coverage and food-security visit guide. Open People & gardens to start a visit with the participant already selected.

features.native: Tirhisa Ku dyondza eka nhluvuko wa mimojulu ni Ndzetelo eka ku va kona, switifikheti ni mavonelo. Eka riendzo ra le masin’wini, rekhoda vuswikoti leswi voniweke ni goza leri landzelaka, loyi a nga ni vutihlamuleri ni siku.
features.source: Use Learning for module progress and Training for attendance, certificates and feedback. In a field visit, record the skill observed and the next action, owner and date.

features.native: Pimanisa mintlawa, swirhapa ni mintirho leyi rekhodiweke. Pfula Mikambelo ku kambela magoza ya swivutiso ni tinhlamulo.
features.source: Compare groups, gardens and recorded activity. Open Assessments to review the survey stages and responses.

features.native: Ndzetelo ni nhluvuko swi hlanganisa vumbhoni bya ndzetelo ni bya phurojeke. Swiviko swi lunghisa rhekhodo ya nongonoko leswaku yi kambisisiwa ni ku avelaniwa.
features.source: Training & progress brings training and project evidence together. Reports prepares the programme record for review and sharing.

features.native: Kambela tinhlayo ta ntlawa ni tichati, kutani Nhluvuko ni magoza ya nkoka leswaku u vona rhekhodo yo anama ya nongonoko.
features.source: Explore cohort totals and charts, then Progress & milestones for the wider programme record.

features.native: Pfula mikambelo ni swiviko leswi avelaniweke ku vona tirhekhodo leti seketelaka tinhlayo ni mintirho leyi faneleke ku hetisiwa.
features.source: Open shared assessments and reports to see the records supporting the totals and the work still to be completed.

features.native: Tindhawu ni swiviko leswi hlayisiweke swi hlanganisa ndhawu yin’wana ni yin’wana ni swiviko swa yona. Hlawula ndhawu leswaku u endla xiviko hi vuxokoxoko bya yona bya sweswi.
features.source: Saved sites & reports connects each site to its reports. Choose a site to create a report from its current information.

features.native: Kambela nxaxamelo wa ndhawu wa swifaniso, swikambelo swa misava ni mati, tinhlamulo ta swivutiso ni mintirho yo dizayina. Kopa xiviko xa vumbhoni ku vona tsalwa leri heleleke.
features.source: Review the site checklist for photographs, soil and water tests, survey answers and design work. Download the evidence report to see the finished document.

features.native: Hlawula Kombela xitirhisiwa ku hlamusela ku cinca ni pheji ya app. Kopa fayili ya mpfapfarhuto wa wena, kumbe u nghena ku wu rhumela eka muendli wa app.
features.source: Choose Request a feature to describe the change and the app page. Download a copy of your draft, or sign in to send it to the developer.

features.native: Vulani garaṱa ya ngade u vhona mulimi wayo, zwifanyiso na fhethu ha u zwala. Shumisani mapa u ṱola hune ya vha hone.
features.source: Open a garden card to see its grower, photographs and growing areas. Use the map to explore where it is.

features.native: Zwititshi zwi tevhelaho zwi ṱumanya pulane ya ngade na ngudo dzayo, khaṋo, thengiso na mivhigo ya mbekanyamushumo.
features.source: The next stops connect a garden design with its studies, harvests, sales and programme reports.

features.native: Nyito ya Mutheo i na tshifanyiso tsha fhethu. Kha Glossy, shumisani Leyara ya fhasi u shandula vhukati ha tshifanyiso tshaṋu, tsha sathaḽaithi na bammbiri ḽi si na tshithu.
features.source: The Base step holds the site image. In Glossy, use Underlay to switch between your photo, satellite and plain paper.

features.native: Nangani muri kana mubete ni u kokodze. Humisela murahu zwi humisela fhethu ha u thoma. Phanele ya Leyara i langa zwithu zwine na nga zwi nanga na u zwi sudzulusa.
features.source: Select a tree or bed and drag it. Undo restores the previous position. The Layers panel controls which items you can select and move.

features.native: Nangani Gethe kha Zwifhaṱo. Kokodzani tshifaro tshayo tsha mudala u i vhea; tshifaro tsha musuku tsha magumoni tshi shandula vhulapfu hayo. Mapa wo fhelelaho u sumbedza gethe yo vulea na u sia tshikhala kha luhura.
features.source: Choose a Gate in Structures. Drag its green move handle to position it; the gold end handle changes its length. The finished map shows the gate open and leaves an opening in the fence.

features.native: Vulani Glossy, nangani siaṱari na leyara yaḽo ya fhasi, ni kone u ita Mapa wa Pulane. Ṱolani mvelelo kha tshikirini tshoṱhe ni shumise Rumelani na Kovhani kha masiaṱari e na nanga.
features.source: Open Glossy, choose a sheet and its underlay, then create a Design Map. Inspect the result full screen and use Export & Share for your selected sheets.

features.native: Shumisani Thomani u guda kana Bvelani phanḓa ni tshi guda u vula moḓulu waṋu u tevhelaho. Garaṱa dza zwifanyiso dzi sumbedza ṱhoho na mvelaphanḓa yaṋu.
features.source: Use Start studying or Continue learning to open your next module. Illustrated cards show the topics and your progress.

features.native: Vulani Seeds and Seed Sovereignty u lingedza moḓulu wo fhelelaho. Nangani tshifanyiso kana ṱhoho ya ngudo u vhala, u thetshelesa, u sedza siḽaidi na u fhindula mbudziso.
features.source: Open Seeds and Seed Sovereignty to try a finished module. Choose a lesson picture or title to read, listen, watch slides and answer a quiz.

features.native: Vulani Gudani ni si na inthanethe musi ni tshe na vhuṱumani. Nangani vhuvha ha u kopolola ni vhulunge khoso kana moḓulu muthihi kha founu iyi.
features.source: Open Study offline while you have signal. Choose the download quality and save the course or a single module to this phone.

features.native: Khaṋo i rekhoda khaṋo; Thengiso i rekhoda thengiso; Mbadelo i vhulunga mbadelo; Zwitshati dzi ṱanganya mbalo. Shandulani thebu u tevhela mushumo u bva kha tshilimwa u ya kha mali.
features.source: Picked records harvests; Sold records sales; Spent holds costs; Charts brings the figures together. Switch tabs to follow the work from crop to cash.

features.native: Vulani Invoisi, ni kone Zwo vhulungwa, u ṱola ḽiṅwalo. Kha Mbadelo, vulani rasithi u vhona zwidodombedzwa zwa u renga zwi tshimbidzanaho na mbadelo.
features.source: Open Invoice, then Saved, to inspect a document. In Spent, open a receipt to see the purchase details behind a cost.

features.native: Kha Khaṋo, vulani Rekhodo dza mubolekisi u vhona ḓivhazwakale ya khaṋo, masheleni a dzhenaho na mbadelo ni rumele manweledzo sa faela.
features.source: In Picked, open Records for a lender to view harvest, income and cost history and export the summary.

features.native: Mushumo wa masimuni u vula mishumo ine ya tea u itwa, uri ndi vhafhio vhashelamulenzhe vho no swikelwaho, na vhulivhisi ha lwendo lwa tsireledzo ya zwiḽiwa. Vulani Vhathu na ngade u thoma lwendo mushelamulenzhe o no nangwa.
features.source: Fieldwork opens your due actions, participant coverage and food-security visit guide. Open People & gardens to start a visit with the participant already selected.

features.native: Shumisani U guda kha mvelaphanḓa ya mimoḓulu na Vhugudisi kha u vha hone, ṱhanziela na mbuyedzedzo. Kha lwendo lwa masimuni, rekhodani vhukoni ho vhonwaho na nyito i tevhelaho, ane a ḓo i ita na datumu.
features.source: Use Learning for module progress and Training for attendance, certificates and feedback. In a field visit, record the skill observed and the next action, owner and date.

features.native: Vhambedzani zwigwada, ngade na mushumo wo rekhodiwaho. Vulani Ṱhaṱhuvho u ṱola maga a mbudziso na phindulo.
features.source: Compare groups, gardens and recorded activity. Open Assessments to review the survey stages and responses.

features.native: Vhugudisi na mvelaphanḓa zwi ṱanganya vhuṱanzi ha vhugudisi na ha thandela. Mivhigo i lugisela rekhodo ya mbekanyamushumo uri i ṱolwe na u kovhiwa.
features.source: Training & progress brings training and project evidence together. Reports prepares the programme record for review and sharing.

features.native: Ṱolani mbalo dza tshigwada na zwitshati, ni kone Mvelaphanḓa na zwiga zwa ndeme u wana rekhodo yo ṱanḓavhuwaho ya mbekanyamushumo.
features.source: Explore cohort totals and charts, then Progress & milestones for the wider programme record.

features.native: Vulani ṱhaṱhuvho na mivhigo yo kovhiwaho u vhona rekhodo dzi tikedzaho mbalo na mushumo u sa athu u fhedzwa.
features.source: Open shared assessments and reports to see the records supporting the totals and the work still to be completed.

features.native: Fhethu na mivhigo zwo vhulungwaho zwi ṱumanya fhethu huṅwe na huṅwe na mivhigo yaho. Nangani fhethu u ita muvhigo nga mafhungo aho a zwino.
features.source: Saved sites & reports connects each site to its reports. Choose a site to create a report from its current information.

features.native: Ṱolani mutevhe wa fhethu wa zwifanyiso, milingo ya mavu na maḓi, phindulo dza mbudziso na mushumo wa u pulana. Kopololani muvhigo wa vhuṱanzi u vhona ḽiṅwalo ḽo fhelelaho.
features.source: Review the site checklist for photographs, soil and water tests, survey answers and design work. Download the evidence report to see the finished document.

features.native: Nangani Humbelani tshumelo u ṱalutshedza tshanduko na siaṱari ḽa app. Kopololani faela ya mvetamveto yaṋu, kana ni dzhene u i rumela kha muḓivhi wa app.
features.source: Choose Request a feature to describe the change and the app page. Download a copy of your draft, or sign in to send it to the developer.

negative.readingRule: Letter/number ranges; three interior hit points avoid inline glyph overhang/trailing whitespace. Ignore intentional header-title ellipsis (full h1 checked separately). Transparent data-tour-stop action layers may receive hits only for noninteractive text in their own article.

boundaries: All browser contexts were disposable and closed in finally; service workers blocked; explicit onboarding/consent fixtures, so no claim of consent-flow coverage.

Anonymous actual chooser/menu/Tour pages and real global ProductTourProvider. One genuine Next Open this view arrival to /samples/gardens per language. Other feature arrivals use synthetic history pathname changes on the actual provider, with the existing page retained; not protected-page end-to-end visits.
All 9 source-backed step previews and 21 actual-provider tips per language, all four width/theme combinations, plus expanded English source and real Next tip/pagination/save-failure handlers.
The AccountButton uses its actual JSX body with fixture-only authentication and a header for layout clearance; no real sign-out or account read/write.
Storage-refusal hooks only touched each disposable context and were restored. No feedback sent, no paid generation, no PDF or geometry mutation.

Intentional compact header-title ellipsis is excluded from reading ranges; the complete page h1 and action bounds are checked. Pure punctuation/whitespace is excluded from line counts. Transparent card action hits are allowed solely for noninteractive text in that same source card; source toggles must remain interactive.
